description.en: MiMo's 30-day Token Plan usage and model listing carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供 MiMo 30 天 Token Plan 用量及模型目录。

description.en: Add the serving key and, optionally, a console cookie for quota refresh.
description.zh: 填写推理密钥，并可选补充用于刷新额度的控制台 Cookie。

help_text.en: Optional. Paste the full cookie block from platform.xiaomimimo.com to refresh the 30-day quota. Re-paste it when the session expires.
help_text.zh: 可选。从 platform.xiaomimimo.com 粘贴完整 Cookie，用于刷新 30 天额度；登录态过期后需重新粘贴。
